source_of_truth: financial_tools/cap263a/interview.py + taxonomy/interview.yaml (Phase E Gates 0-10); gateT from the new tangible-property engine spec

renderer_contract.conditions: A condition is one of: {question, equals}, {question, in:[..]}, {question, lte:n}, {question, answered:bool}, {derived, equals}, {any:[conds]}, {all:[conds]}, {differs:[qidA,qidB]}. Every entry of a show_if/when list must hold (AND).
renderer_contract.unanswered_semantics: An unanswered question evaluates as null. For bool questions {equals:false} matches null OR false (falsy semantics, mirroring interview.py where never-asked answers are None/falsy). {equals:true}, {in:[..]}, {lte:n} and choice {equals:v} never match null. {derived:.., equals:null} tests the three-valued 'unknown' state.
renderer_contract.gate_skip: A gate with skip_if whose conditions all hold is skipped entirely (mirrors interview.py _EXEMPT_SKIPPED_GATES: gates 1,2,3,6,7 are §263A provisions and switch off for a §448(c)-exempt small business; gates 4,5,8,9,10 and gateT still run).
renderer_contract.maps_to: Exactly one of profile_field (EntityProfile attribute), flag (interview flag name), election_kwarg (run_engagement / engine kwarg). Answers land on the profile object the HTML engines consume.
renderer_contract.schedules: requires_schedule_if adds the named schedule tab(s) to the required list when the answer matches. always_required_schedules are appended unconditionally.

under_448c_threshold.description: Q0.4 <= the §448(c) inflation-indexed threshold for Q0.2's year (EntityProfile.THRESHOLDS; unknown years fall back to the 2026 figure and should be flagged as an estimate). null while Q0.4 is unanswered.

small_business_exempt.description: under_448c_threshold AND Q0.3 (tax shelter) is false — §263A(i)/§448(c) small-business exemption; §1.263A-1(b)(1)/(j) bars a tax shelter regardless of receipts. false while receipts are unanswered (interview.py treats undetermined as not-exempt for gate walking, then warns EXEMPTION-UNDETERMINED).

srm_available.description: Gate 1 consequence matrix, §1.263A-3(a)(4) — three-valued. null: Q1.1a unanswered, or a producer whose Q1.2 de minimis determination was never established. true: not a producer (pure reseller), or private-label goods (Q1.4), or de-minimis production incident to resale (Q1.2=de_minimis AND Q1.3). false: otherwise (producer above de minimis with no carve-out) — SPM/MSPM only.

gates.title: Entity & exemption
gates.purpose: Identify the taxpayer, the tax year, and whether the §448(c)/§263A(i) small-business exemption switches all of §263A off (Gates 1-3, 6-7 skipped).

questions.text: What type of entity is the taxpayer?
questions.help: Determines who signs elections and unlocks partnership-only questions (guaranteed payments, §707(c); syndication costs, §709(b)). §448.

questions.text: What tax year is this engagement for?
questions.help: Sets the §448(c) gross-receipts threshold lookup ($30M/2024, $31M/2025, $32M/2026) and the T.D. 10034 pre/post-Oct-2025 interest-capitalization regime.

questions.text: Is the taxpayer a tax shelter under §448(a)(3) (syndicate / loss-allocation tests)?
questions.help: A §448(a)(3) tax shelter is statutorily barred from the small-business exemption regardless of gross receipts. §1.263A-1(b)(1)/(j).

questions.text: Aggregated 3-year average annual gross receipts under §448(c)(2)/§1.448-2 (related entities combined)?
questions.help: Must be the single-employer AGGREGATED figure, not this entity's receipts alone. At or under the threshold (and not a tax shelter): all of §263A — including (f) interest — is off; Gates 1-3 and 6-7 are skipped. §448(c)(2); §1.448-2.

questions.text: Is this the first taxable year with production or resale activities?
questions.help: In the first §263A year, methods below are ADOPTED — no Form 3115 and no prior-method reconciliation. §1.263A-7(a).

questions.text: What §263A method was established last year?
questions.help: Any divergence from this year's method-of-accounting answers triggers Form 3115 / §481(a) and §1.263A-7 revalued beginning-inventory inputs. §446(e); §1.263A-7.

gates.title: Producer / reseller status
gates.purpose: Establish producer vs reseller status and the §1.263A-3(a)(4) SRM-availability consequence matrix (computed, not asked).

questions.text: Does the taxpayer produce real or tangible personal property?
questions.help: Producer status under §1.263A-2(a) — construction, manufacturing, growing, improvement all count.

questions.text: Does the taxpayer acquire property for resale?
questions.help: Reseller status under §1.263A-3(a).

questions.text: Are production gross receipts and production labor each 10% or less of the trade or business (the de minimis presumption)?
questions.help: The 10%/10% presumption of §1.263A-3(a)(5)(ii). Above either threshold, the facts-and-circumstances follow-up is an SME review-queue call, not a formula.

questions.text: Is the de minimis production incident to resale of §1221(a)(1) property?
questions.help: The §1.263A-3(a)(4)(ii) route that keeps SRM available for a de-minimis producer.

questions.text: Private-label production — goods produced under contract by an UNRELATED party, incident to resale, sold to customers?
questions.help: Asked always (not gated on Q1.3): the §1.263A-3(a)(4)(iii) private-label carve-out can qualify even a more-than-de-minimis producer for SRM.

gates.title: Inventory & §263A method elections
gates.purpose: Inventory method, this year's §263A simplified method, and the SSCM / HAR / split sub-elections.

questions.text: What inventory method is established?
questions.help: §471/§472 established method. LIFO routes the MSPM combined-ratio and SRM increment mechanics.

questions.text: Which §263A method applies this year?
questions.help: SPM/MSPM per §1.263A-2; SRM per §1.263A-3. The menu is constrained by Gate 1's srm_available matrix; differing from Q0.6 in a non-first year requires Form 3115 / §481(a) (see derived checks).

questions.text: (SPM only) Are 3-year average gross receipts over $50 million?
questions.help: §1.263A-1(d)(3)(ii)(B)(1): a producer over $50M may not include negative §263A adjustments under the SPM (MSPM has no size limit).

questions.text: Include negative §263A adjustments?
questions.help: §1.263A-1(d)(3)(ii). Not offered to an over-$50M SPM taxpayer. If yes, the (d)(3)(ii)(C)-(E) restrictions apply.

warning_if.text: §1.263A-1(d)(3)(ii)(C)-(E): no negative adjustments for cash/trade discounts or §162(c)/(e)/(f)/(g) items; consistency required.

questions.text: (Producers) Are total indirect costs $200,000 or less (after excluding not-required-to-capitalize categories; related parties aggregated)?
questions.help: §1.263A-2(b)(3)(iv): if yes, additional §263A costs are DEEMED ZERO — the ratio-input questions below are skipped and the HAR election is barred.

questions.text: (MSPM) Has the taxpayer used MSPM with actual ratios for 3 or more consecutive prior years?
questions.help: Eligibility fact for the Historic Absorption Ratio election. §1.263A-2(c)(4).

questions.text: Elect the Historic Absorption Ratio (HAR)?
questions.help: §1.263A-2(c)(4) — MSPM-only, applied on a cut-off basis; frozen ratio and qualifying-year inputs are then required.

questions.text: HAR: frozen PRE-PRODUCTION historic absorption ratio (fraction)?
questions.help: Frozen for the 5-year qualifying period. §1.263A-2(c)(4).

questions.text: HAR: frozen PRODUCTION historic absorption ratio (fraction)?
questions.help: Frozen for the 5-year qualifying period. §1.263A-2(c)(4).

questions.text: HAR (LIFO): frozen COMBINED historic absorption ratio (fraction)?
questions.help: The LIFO variant uses a single combined ratio. §1.263A-2(c)(4)(iii).

questions.text: HAR: qualifying-year index (1-5 within the qualifying period; 6 = recomputation year)?
questions.help: §1.263A-2(c)(4): in the recomputation year, BOTH frozen ratios must be within ±0.5 percentage points of actuals (conjunctive) — pass extends 6 years; fail means actuals now with mandatory resumption in the 3rd following year.

questions.text: (MSPM) SSCM-split method — direct-material or labor?
questions.help: How capitalizable mixed-service costs split between the pre-production and production pools. §1.263A-2(c)(3)(iii)(B).

questions.text: (MSPM) Elect the 90% one-bucket split?
questions.help: §1.263A-2(c)(3)(iii)(C): if 90% or more of capitalizable mixed-service costs would land in one pool, elect to put ALL of them there.

questions.text: Elect the simplified service cost method (SSCM)?
questions.help: §1.263A-1(h): allocates mixed-service costs by a simple ratio instead of department-level allocation.

questions.text: SSCM ratio method?
questions.help: §1.263A-1(h)(3)(ii): the production-cost ratio is offered ONLY to producers; a reseller must use the labor-based ratio (see derived check SSCM-RATIO-RESELLER).

questions.text: SSCM: elect to EXCLUDE self-constructed assets?
questions.help: §1.263A-1(h)(2)(ii): routes self-constructed-asset mixed costs to the general (g)(4) method instead of SSCM.

questions.text: Elect the (g)(4)(ii) all-departments 90% mixed-service treatment?
questions.help: §1.263A-1(g)(4)(ii). Note: the department-level carve-out mechanics are not built in this tool — setting this triggers an honesty-gate warning downstream.

questions.text: Book-conformity check: does financial-statement capitalization match the §471 / Additional-§263A tier split (including TD 9843 elective methods (d)(2)(iii)/(iv)/(v))?
questions.help: §1.263A-1(d)(2); TD 9843. A review-queue flag, not a computed field.

gates.title: Method inputs (SPM / MSPM / SRM balances)
gates.purpose: The dollar inputs each simplified method needs. Menu strictly follows Q2.2; all inputs suppressed when Q2.5's $200K deemed-zero applies.

questions.text: (SPM) §471 costs remaining in ending inventory?
questions.help: The SPM absorption ratio's multiplicand. §1.263A-2(b).

questions.text: (MSPM) Pre-production §471 costs incurred during the year (direct material + resale)?
(MSPM) Production §471 costs incurred during the year?
(MSPM) Pre-production additional §263A costs incurred?
(MSPM) Production additional §263A costs incurred?
(MSPM) Pre-production §471 costs on hand at year end (current-year-incurred only)?
(MSPM) Production §471 costs on hand at year end (current-year-incurred only)?
(MSPM) Beginning direct materials not yet in production?
questions.help: §1.263A-2(c)(3); feeds the direct-materials adjustment.

questions.text: (MSPM) Ending direct materials not yet in production?
questions.help: §1.263A-2(c)(3); feeds the direct-materials adjustment.

questions.text: (MSPM) Direct materials purchased during the year?
questions.help: Feeds the direct-materials adjustment. §1.263A-2(c)(3).

questions.text: (MSPM, LIFO) Current-year LIFO increment stated in §471 costs?
questions.help: The combined absorption ratio's multiplicand under §1.263A-2(c)(3)(iv) (the regulation's Example 3: 9.48% × $1,500,000 increment). Without it the engine warns MSPM-LIFO-INCREMENT-MISSING.

questions.text: (SRM) Current year's purchases — §471 costs incurred on property acquired for resale during the year?
questions.help: The purchasing-ratio DENOMINATOR. §1.263A-3(d)(3).

questions.text: (SRM) Purchasing-department cost pool?
questions.help: The purchasing-ratio NUMERATOR. §1.263A-3(d)(3).

questions.text: (SRM) Storage and handling costs?
questions.help: The storage-and-handling ratio's numerator pool. §1.263A-3(d)(3).

questions.text: (SRM) Beginning inventory §471 costs (LIFO carrying value if Q2.1 is LIFO)?
questions.help: Part of the S&H ratio denominator (unless variation A excludes it). §1.263A-3(d)(3).

questions.text: (SRM) §471 costs remaining on hand at year end (LIFO: the current-year increment, unless variation B is elected)?
questions.help: The combined ratio's multiplicand. §1.263A-3(d)(3)(i)(C).

questions.text: (SRM) Elect the 1/3-2/3 purchasing-labor allocation (all-or-nothing)?
questions.help: §1.263A-3(d): dual-function purchasing personnel may be allocated 1/3-2/3 instead of by time — but for ALL such personnel or none.

questions.text: (SRM) Permissible variation A — exclude beginning inventory from the storage-and-handling denominator?
questions.help: §1.263A-3(d)(3)(iii)(A). A method of accounting once used.

questions.text: (SRM, LIFO) Permissible variation B — multiply the S&H ratio by TOTAL ending-inventory §471 costs instead of the increment?
questions.help: §1.263A-3(d)(3)(iii)(B). Requires the total ending-inventory §471 figure at LIFO carrying value (see completeness rule SRM-VARIATION-B-INPUT-MISSING).

gates.title: §263(a) tangible-property facts & elections (interview.py Gate 4)
gates.purpose: AFS / written-policy facts and the annual tangible-property elections as interview.py records them (flags). gateT below carries the same three elections as engine kwargs for the new tangible engine.

questions.text: Does the taxpayer have an applicable financial statement (AFS)?
questions.help: Sets the de minimis safe-harbor ceiling authority: $5,000 per invoice/item with an AFS, $2,500 without (Notice 2015-82 raise of the reg's $500). §1.263(a)-1(f)(1).

questions.text: Were written accounting procedures in place at the BEGINNING of the year?
questions.help: A precondition of the de minimis safe harbor. §1.263(a)-1(f)(1)(i)(B)/(ii)(B).

questions.text: Elect the de minimis safe harbor this year?
questions.help: §1.263(a)-1(f): an ANNUAL statement election, irrevocable for the year — NOT a method change ((f)(5)).

questions.text: Small-taxpayer building safe harbor: are average gross receipts $10M or less under §1.263(a)-3(h)(3)'s OWN definition (not §448(c))?
questions.help: §1.263(a)-3(h)(3) has its own receipts test — do not reuse the Q0.4 §448(c) figure.

questions.text: Elect to capitalize repairs following books (§1.263(a)-3(n))?
questions.help: An ANNUAL election that ADDS capitalization of amounts otherwise deductible as repairs, conforming tax to book capitalization.

gates.title: §266 carrying-charge elections
gates.purpose: Elective capitalization of taxes and carrying charges.

questions.text: Is property unimproved AND unproductive this year — elect §266 capitalization of taxes/carrying charges?
questions.help: §1.266-1(b)(1)(i): an annual, year-by-year election.

questions.text: Development/construction project — elect §266 capitalization?
questions.help: §1.266-1(b)(1)(ii): sticks until the work completes. ORDERING NOTE: for an asset flagged in BOTH Gate 5 and Gate 7, §§1.263A-8..-15 apply FIRST (§1.266-1(a)(2)).

questions.text: Was the §266 election statement confirmed filed with the original return?
questions.help: §1.266-1(c)(3) requires a statement with the original return.

gates.title: Self-constructed assets
gates.purpose: Presence screen for the SCA engine (per-asset detail lives in the Self-Constructed Assets tab, not the wizard).

questions.text: Any self-constructed assets (SCA) this year?
questions.help: If yes, the fixed-asset and CIP schedules are required and the per-asset SCA detail (cost-allocation method, SSCM eligibility route, pool/driver assignments) is entered on the SCA tab.

gates.title: §263A(f) interest capitalization
gates.purpose: Designated-property presence screen and the taxpayer-level interest-method answers (per-unit and per-debt detail lives in the §263A(f) tab).

questions.text: Any §263A(f) designated-property candidates?
questions.help: §1.263A-8(b): real property, or tangible personal property with a long class life / production period. If yes, CIP and debt schedules are required.

questions.text: Computation period and measurement-date frequency?
questions.help: §1.263A-9(f): the taxpayer's chosen computation period (e.g. annual, quarterly) and measurement dates — a method of accounting.

questions.text: Tracing posture: trace, §1.263A-9(d) no-tracing election, or AFR-plus-3?
questions.help: §1.263A-8/-9. AFR-plus-3 requires the $10M since-1994 receipts test OR the small-business route and forecloses tracing.

questions.text: Since-1994 average annual gross receipts (for the AFR-plus-3 $10M eligibility test)?
questions.help: A LONGER look-back window than Q0.4's 3-year §448(c) test — do not reuse Q0.4.

questions.text: Accounts-payable fold-in sub-election (lowers the WAIR denominator)?
questions.help: §1.263A-9(d)(1): available under the no-tracing election.

questions.text: (Partnerships) Guaranteed payments for the use of capital?
questions.help: §1.263A-9(c)(2)(iii); §707(c): treated as interest for the avoided-cost computation.

gates.title: §174/§174A research & experimental
gates.purpose: R&E presence screen, the §174A(c) capitalization election, and the OBBBA 2022-2024 catch-up options (per-project detail lives in the R&E tab).

questions.text: Any R&E-tagged costs (§174/§174A)?
questions.help: If yes, the R&E schedule is required; domestic vs foreign detail is entered per project on the R&E tab.

questions.text: (Domestic) Elect 60-month-or-longer capitalization instead of current expensing, per §174A(c)?
questions.help: §174A(c): an elective capitalization of domestic R&E that would otherwise be currently expensed.

questions.text: Elected capitalization period in months (minimum 60)?
Is 2022-2024 domestic R&E still being amortized under the old 5-year schedule?
questions.help: OBBBA transition: unamortized 2022-2024 domestic R&E can be caught up.

questions.text: Catch-up method: 1-year (all in 2025) or 2-year (split 2025-2026)?
questions.help: OBBBA transition. Mutually exclusive with Q8.4's retroactive election.

questions.text: (Small business at or under the §448(c) threshold) Elect the RETROACTIVE amendment instead of the catch-up?
questions.help: OBBBA small-business retroactive election — amended-return deadline July 6, 2026. Mutually exclusive with Q8.3b. Eligibility keys off Q0.4 (not re-asked).

questions.text: Are software development costs among these expenditures?
questions.help: §174/§174A software scope is an SME confirmation — a review-queue flag.

gates.title: Transaction costs, intangibles, start-up, §1060
gates.purpose: Presence screens that route the intangibles/transaction-cost/start-up/PPA schedules (per-transaction and per-intangible detail lives in those tabs).

questions.text: Any flagged transaction or intangible-tagged costs (§1.263(a)-4/-5)?
questions.help: If yes: transaction-cost, intangibles, and start-up schedules are required; covered-transaction, bright-line-date, 12-month-rule, and $5K-cliff detail is entered per item on those tabs.

questions.text: Is a start-up or organizational cost pool present?
questions.help: §195/§248/§709: $5,000 first-year allowance with a $50,000 phase-out, 180-month amortization from business commencement (totals and dates are entered on the start-up tab).

questions.text: (Partnerships) Does any portion represent SYNDICATION costs under §709(b) (fees to promote or sell partnership interests)?
questions.help: §709(b): syndication costs are PERMANENTLY non-amortizable — not on the $5,000/180-month schedule.

warning_if.text: §709(b) syndication costs: PERMANENT non-amortization, not the $5,000/180-month schedule.

questions.text: Acquired a trade or business this year (asset acquisition or deemed asset acquisition under §338)?
questions.help: §1060; §338. If yes, the Form 8594 residual-method PPA schedule is required and SEEDS basis for the per-asset gates — complete it before Gate 3/6/7 detail for acquired assets.

gates.title: §59(e) qualified expenditures
gates.purpose: AMT-exposure gating for the §59(e) election (per-expenditure elections are entered on the §59(e) tab).

questions.text: Is the taxpayer an individual, or a pass-through entity whose owners may report AMT preference items (§55/§56/§57 individual AMT)?
questions.help: §59(e) only matters where individual AMT can apply — TCJA repealed corporate AMT and the IRA 2022 CAMT does not use §57 preferences. If no (pure C-corp, no AMT-exposed owners), the rest of Gate 10 is skipped.

gates.title: Tangible-property engine elections (NEW — not from interview.py)
gates.purpose: The three annual tangible-property elections the NEW standalone tangible engine consumes as engine kwargs. Conditions reuse gate4's fact questions (Q4.1a/Q4.1b/Q4.2a) rather than re-asking them; gate4's Q4.1c/Q4.4a record the same facts as interview flags for the workpaper summary.

questions.text: Apply the de minimis safe harbor election in the tangible-property computation?
questions.help: §1.263(a)-1(f): deducts items at or under the ceiling — $5,000 per invoice/item with an AFS (Q4.1a), $2,500 without (Notice 2015-82). Requires written accounting procedures in place at the beginning of the year (Q4.1b); an annual, irrevocable-for-the-year statement election.

questions.text: Apply the small-taxpayer building safe harbor election?
questions.help: §1.263(a)-3(h): a qualifying small taxpayer (≤$10M receipts under (h)(3)'s own test — Q4.2a) may deduct repairs/improvements on a building with unadjusted basis ≤$1M when the year's total is ≤ the lesser of 2% of basis or $10,000. Annual, per-building.

questions.text: Apply the election to capitalize repairs following books?
questions.help: §1.263(a)-3(n): an annual election to capitalize for tax any repair amounts capitalized on the books — it ADDS capitalization, never reduces it.

derived_checks.text: Q2.2 = SRM but Gate 1's consequence matrix makes SRM unavailable (producer above de minimis, no incident-to-resale route, no private-label goods) — SPM/MSPM only (§1.263A-3(a)(4)).
Q2.2 = SRM but the de minimis determination (Q1.2) was never established for this producer — the §1.263A-3(a)(4) availability gate cannot be evaluated. Resolve Gate 1 before relying on SRM figures.
The production-cost allocation ratio is a producer-only formula (§1.263A-1(h)(3)(ii)) — a reseller electing it is a regulation violation; use the labor-based ratio.

The Q0.6 prior-year method was never legally available for this activity profile — a discovered impermissible method, an error-correction event under §446(e) (Form 3115 with a different DCN/§481(a) posture than an elective switch).
This year's §263A method (Q2.2) differs from the established prior-year method (Q0.6) — Form 3115, a §481(a) adjustment, and §1.263A-7 revalued beginning-inventory inputs are required.

Q0.4 (aggregated 3-yr average gross receipts) was not answered — the §448(c) exemption CANNOT be determined. The profile's receipts default to $0, which downstream reads as EXEMPT (all §263A off); supply Q0.4 before relying on any computation.

produces=False but production_activity_level='more_than_de_minimis' — the SRM availability gate cannot be evaluated on contradictory inputs. Fix the activity profile. (Mirrors engines/inventory.py; unreachable through the wizard flow itself but fires on imported profiles.)

completeness.question: What is the current-year LIFO increment stated in §471 costs? Without it the MSPM result is the NON-LIFO computation, not the combined-ratio × increment answer (§1.263A-2(c)(3)(iv)).
The HAR election is set but the frozen pre-production and production historic absorption ratios are missing — without them ACTUAL ratios are used (§1.263A-2(c)(4)). Supply both frozen ratios.
The HAR election under LIFO needs the frozen COMBINED historic absorption ratio (§1.263A-2(c)(4)(iii)) — without it the actual combined ratio is used. Supply the frozen combined ratio.

What is the pre-production share of labor (pre-production labor ÷ total labor, both excluding mixed-service labor), as a fraction? Required by the §1.263A-2(c)(3)(iii)(B) labor split method — without it the engine silently falls back to the direct-material proportion. (No interview.py question exists for this field.)

Variation B needs TOTAL ending-inventory §471 costs at LIFO carrying value — the S&H ratio's multiplicand under §1.263A-3(d)(3)(iii)(B) (the purchasing ratio still multiplies the current-year increment). Without it the computation runs WITHOUT the variation. (No interview.py question exists for this field.)

The taxpayer produces but the de minimis determination (Q1.2) was never established — the §1.263A-3(a)(4) SRM availability gate cannot be evaluated. Establish the production activity level before relying on SRM figures.

What is the highest applicable Federal rate (§1274(d)) in effect during the computation period (as a decimal fraction)? If no eligible nontraced debt is outstanding, §1.263A-9(c)(5)(iii)(D) substitutes this rate for the WAIR — without it, excess-expenditure amounts compute as ZERO. (Only consumed when the debt schedule leaves no nontraced debt; ask up front since the wizard cannot see the debt balances.)
